origin: Origin: original procedural WebGL artwork, rendered from scene.js with self-hosted Three.js r170 and render-assets.cjs in Chromium / ANGLE SwiftShader. Not AI image generation, sourced photography, or copied reference assets. Seven unchanged tapered translucent iridescent mineral membranes; five smoothly eroded cohesive mineral masses, world-space nonperiodic fBm grain and warped seams, localized moss, a displaced continuous mineral floor, bank-localized talus and soft directional contact shadows. Original painted radiance map, point/directional optical lights, dust and light shafts. Wide and portrait cameras independently framed; Threshold, Practice, Curiosity and Contact lateral optical views. No reference-source pixels, models, geometry or shaders reused. Exact renderer version, source/generator SHA256 and raster SHA256 recorded in raster-provenance.json; origin embedded in each JPEG COM marker.
generation: Seven unchanged tapered optical membranes, physical transmission .94, iridescence .7, IOR 1.36; five smooth eroded mineral masses, 76 bank-localized talus pieces, displaced continuous ground; world-space interpolated value-noise/fBm grain, warped seams, localized moss and directional PCF-soft contact shadows. Original painted radiance environment, unchanged optical lights and lateral camera; four views with separately authored wide/portrait framing.
